# mewvi by Clyvora

> Free public-media downloading and private, on-device audio and video conversion. Formerly Clyvora Convert. Currently in beta.

## Product
- [Downloader](https://mewvi.xyz/): Paste a supported public media link; choose Auto, Audio or Video only. No account required. Download availability varies by source, region, rate limits and backend availability.
- [Local converter](https://mewvi.xyz/local): Convert selected audio/video files in the browser with FFmpeg WebAssembly. Local file contents stay on the device. Device resources and the processing build affect format support.
- [How it works](https://mewvi.xyz/about): Public-link downloads use Clyvora infrastructure; local conversion runs on the device.
- [Updates](https://mewvi.xyz/updates): Current beta release notes and limitations.

## Important distinctions
Spotify track links find matching audio on YouTube; this is not native Spotify audio. Albums, playlists and private Spotify links are not supported by this adapter. Other platforms may support public collection discovery, depending on the extractor. A catalog entry is not a verified guarantee for every link.

No DRM, paywall or account-access bypass is offered. Use media you own or have permission to download. The service does not guarantee recovery of quality missing from a source, permanent download storage, or uninterrupted availability.

## Trust and support
